summary: This Best Current Practice describes the IETF Administrative Support Activity, set up inside the Internet Society. It defines the roles of the IETF Administrative Oversight Committee, the IETF Administrative Director, and ISOC in the IETF's administration. It was replaced by RFC 8711.

eli5.summary: The IETF needs people to handle money, contracts and office tasks. This document explains who does what in that support team. It was later replaced by RFC 8711.
